newsitem.title: UK: Healthier prompt Brent squeezes contango further.
newsitem.headline: Healthier prompt Brent squeezes contango further.

text.p: North Sea Brent intermonth spreads made further gains on Wednesday afternoon, narrowing the contango on the paper curve as the prompt market showed signs of recovery.
The May/June spread was talked around -16/-12 cents having traded at -16 cents earlier, while June/July firmer to -6/-3 cents.
Dated Brent loading April 18-20 traded at May Brent -82 cents earlier, 10 cents above Tuesday's traded levels.
Two other cargoes, loading April 20-22 and 23-25 later traded on a quotes-related basis.
"The differentials are coming up...better refining margins are helping," said the seller.
The CFD market signalled a further improvement in Dated Brent values, with next week's dates (April 14-18) climbing to June Brent -57/-55 cents, or the rough equivalent to May Brent -43/-41 cents.
April 21-25 was pegged at June -46/-40 cents.
Outright May Brent was trading 15 cents up at $18.08 a barrel on the IPE screen at 1458 GMT, off a session high of $18.34.
